_comment: Copy to pipeline/character/<video>/video.json. Written by character-shots (P1) from the locked plan; nothing can be assembled without it. With app_insertion false, it has no O, G, S, H, F, R or P segment. Optional per segment, read by assemble.sh: trim [in, out] in seconds of the source; punch_in; audio_from: '<video>.<seg>' (another approved segment's voice under this one), 'asset:<id>' (a supplied voice or sound approved at gate B, cut to audio_range_s or its trim_s) or 'narration:<take>' (a narrator's take approved at gate B); for R and P screen_id and punch_in_to_hero. For a v2 plan: plan_revision and plan_sha256 (bridge.py digest) pin the plan it was written from, every segment names the plan beats it carries (beat_ids), overlays is the plan's overlays copied exactly, and planned_s may give a segment's planned length. B is a silent generated action (hands only, pet only, or a mascot; never the app); C is supplied media (asset_id, source_range_s for a clip or still_s for a still, fit cover | pad, audio source | mute, and insert {mode, screen_id} for a filmed phone); M lays panels (each one source: asset_id, project of an approved B, or screen_id; source_range_s, rect as shares of the frame, crop, sync_offset_s, audio true on the panel whose sound plays).
plan_sha256: <bridge.py digest of the plan; v2 only>
app_insertion: <true | false, from the plan; false means no O, G, S, H, F, R or P segment>
script_ref: <the frozen script; the user's words and the date>

segments._note: an H or F segment speaks no line; its audio is the demo performance or the next line
the recording with her demo performance in a round bubble; its audio is not trimmed
a silent generated action: hands only, pet only or a mascot; its lines are narration
supplied media, never generated; a still has still_s instead of source_range_s
split_screen or picture_in_picture, copied from the plan's panels

captions.style: house: Helvetica Neue Bold, white, black outline

title_overlay.burn: <true only when the plan asks for it>
title_overlay.until_s: <seconds, or null for the whole video>
title_overlay._note: legacy (v1) only; drawn as one hook overlay. A v2 video carries its text in overlays.

export.grain_test_variant: <the first real use case only: true, a second export with 2 to 3% grain>

voiceover.script_ref: <the frozen script of the video, or of the recording>

in_model.note: the demo performance: she says the demo lines on camera in the set; the audio goes under R, the picture into P

voiceover.delivery: conversational; pace differs by line, as the delivery notes say
imperfections: one small breath before the line that must land
fallback_rules: only where no face is on screen
never a TTS clone of a real person's voice

checks.natural_voice: natural breaths, varied pauses, moving pitch, room sound, no flat TTS cadence
